summary: Implemented canonical JSON contracts with full SHA-256 specification and result identifiers. Before any V3 empirical run, a provenance audit found that the historical preperiod cell input named in the command was not separately enumerated in data.sources; the original stamp was preserved and a provenance-only v2 contract was issued. Mutation and incompatibility tests cover support, membership, scale-relevant construction fields, age, endpoint, objective, calendar, contrast, uncertainty, command, code, environment, and source content.

review.reviewer: execution-agent self-review informed by a separate-agent contract-design challenge
